searchText: What rate of change per block does filecoin use? (and what's the block interval) 30s block interval and 12.5% max change per block Regarding default miner tip, we've set the default quite low, we want to run analysis similar to what Eth has done and figure out the marginal cost of including a message/additional gas in a block but that will be quite different in Filecoin.
